final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id), totals AS (SELECT AVG(address_count) AS avg_addresses_per_city, SUM(address_count) AS total_addresses FROM city_counts) SELECT c.city_id, c.address_count, c.address_count * 1.0 / t.avg_addresses_per_city AS relative_to_average, c.address_count * 1.0 / t.total_addresses AS share_of_all_addresses FROM city_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS t ORDER BY share_of_all_addresses DESC, c.city_id LIMIT 10
